seed: A Corner Radius row whose track starts partway along says so on the track. A rounded box is framed, so the frame masks its corners and can never take them below the curve the box already has: the knob rests on the wall with the refused stretch drawn spent behind it, instead of sitting at the far left looking like a knob at nothing. Then the same row is pulled past the wall, and then a pill is framed, where the whole track is spent and the row is still there undimmed.

steps.note: a box rounded about 18, on its own: the row has no wall, so the track is plain groove behind the knob

the box is now inside a frame, and a frame rounds by masking: it cannot take its corners below the curve the box inside already has. The knob rests on that wall, three tenths along, with the refused stretch behind it drawn spent and a keyline where it stops
pulled past the wall: the fill starts AT the wall, so it measures what was added rather than what was already there
a pill: as round as a box that size goes

a frame around a pill has nothing left to round, so the whole track is spent and the knob sits against the wall at the end. The row is NOT dimmed and NOT removed: it still answers a click with what put the wall there
